mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_in (couple_code, user_id, nickname, mood, love_degree, check_date, create_time) VALUES (#{coupleCode}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{mood}, #{loveDegree}, #{checkDate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM check_in WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_date = #{checkDate}
SELECT * FROM check_in WHERE couple_code = #{coupleCode} AND check_date = #{checkDate} ORDER BY create_time
SELECT c.*, u.avatar FROM check_in c LEFT JOIN couple_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.couple_code = #{coupleCode} ORDER BY c.check_date DESC, c.create_time LIMIT 60
